vcu_0159_0800edfc.name: tmr_flag_get
vcu_0159_0800edfc.summary: Test whether any of the given TMR status flags is set (SDK tmr_flag_get)
vcu_0159_0800edfc.description: Matches the Artery SDK tmr_flag_get: returns true when (tmr->ists & flag) != 0, where ists is the interrupt status register at offset 0x10 of the timer block. Does not clear anything. Only caller is vcu_0159_0800898c, presumably a timer update/overflow ISR checking TMR_OVF_FLAG or similar. Part of the vendor timer driver group (tmr_*) at 0x0800ede0..0800ef0a.

returns.description: true if any masked flag bit is set

vcu_0159_0800ee0a.name: tmr_interrupt_enable
vcu_0159_0800ee0a.summary: Set or clear TMR interrupt-enable bits (SDK tmr_interrupt_enable)
vcu_0159_0800ee0a.description: Matches the Artery SDK tmr_interrupt_enable: with param_3 == 1 ORs param_2 into the IDEN register (offset 0xC); with param_3 == 0 clears those bits; any other value leaves the register unchanged. Called from vcu_0159_0800261c, the timer init code.

vcu_0159_0800ee22.name: tmr_output_channel_config
vcu_0159_0800ee22.summary: Configure a TMR output-compare channel from a tmr_output_config_type (SDK)
vcu_0159_0800ee22.description: Matches the Artery SDK tmr_output_channel_config. param_2 is the channel select value (0,2,4,6 for CH1..CH4, i.e. 2*channel index). param_3 points to a 7-byte tmr_output_config_type: [0] oc_mode, [1] oc_idle_state, [2] occ_idle_state, [3] oc_polarity, [4] occ_polarity, [5] oc_output_state, [6] occ_output_state. It writes the idle-state bits into CTRL2 (bits 8+ch and 9+ch), writes the OC mode (3 bits) into CM1 (offset 0x18) or CM2 (0x1C) at bit 4 or 12, and then sets polarity and enable bits in CCTRL (offset 0x20) at bit positions 2*ch..2*ch+3. Called from the PWM timer init vcu_0159_08001bca (together with tmr_output_default_para_init and tmr_output_enable).
vcu_0159_0800ee22.notes: The decompile does not clear the CxC bit (SDK sets c1c = FALSE); register masks match the SDK otherwise.

vcu_0159_0800eef8.name: tmr_output_default_para_init
vcu_0159_0800eef8.summary: Zero all seven fields of a tmr_output_config_type (SDK)
vcu_0159_0800eef8.description: Matches the Artery SDK tmr_output_default_para_init: clears the 7 byte-wide members (oc_mode, idle states, polarities, output enables) so the struct is in the default state before the caller fills in selected fields and passes it to tmr_output_channel_config. Called from vcu_0159_08001bca.

vcu_0159_0800ef0a.name: tmr_output_enable
vcu_0159_0800ef0a.summary: Set or clear the TMR main output enable (BRK.OEN) bit (SDK)
vcu_0159_0800ef0a.description: Matches the Artery SDK tmr_output_enable: read-modify-write of the BRK register (offset 0x44) bit 15 (OEN) with (param_2 & 1). Needed on advanced timers (TMR1) for PWM outputs to appear on the pins. Called from the PWM setup vcu_0159_08001bca.

vcu_0159_0800ef70.name: crc32_ieee_calc
vcu_0159_0800ef70.summary: Bitwise CRC-32 (IEEE 802.3, poly 0xEDB88320) over a byte buffer
vcu_0159_0800ef70.description: Standard reflected CRC-32 as used by zlib/PNG/Ethernet: starts with 0xFFFFFFFF, XORs each byte into the low bits, then shifts right 8 times applying the polynomial 0xEDB88320 when the low bit is set, and returns the bit-inverted result. No lookup table and does not use the hardware CRC peripheral. Called from vcu_0159_080054ec, likely to verify a stored/received data block (e.g. flash configuration or update image); that purpose is inferred from the caller only.

vcu_0159_0800efa4.name: usart_data_receive
vcu_0159_0800efa4.summary: Read the USART data register (SDK usart_data_receive)
vcu_0159_0800efa4.description: Matches the Artery SDK usart_data_receive: returns the low 16 bits of the DT register (offset 0x4); reading it also clears RDBF and error flags per the hardware sequence. Called from vcu_0159_08008c98, the USART RX interrupt handler (together with usart_flag_get).

returns.description: received data (9-bit max, normally a byte)

vcu_0159_0800efaa.name: usart_dma_receiver_enable
vcu_0159_0800efaa.summary: Enable or disable USART DMA receive request (CTRL3.DMAREN)
vcu_0159_0800efaa.description: Matches the Artery SDK usart_dma_receiver_enable: writes (param_2 & 1) to bit 6 of CTRL3 (offset 0x14). Called with usart_dma_transmitter_enable, usart_transmitter_enable and usart_receiver_enable from vcu_0159_08001ee8, the USART initialisation; the group is the SDK usart driver.

vcu_0159_0800efb4.name: usart_dma_transmitter_enable
vcu_0159_0800efb4.summary: Enable or disable USART DMA transmit request (CTRL3.DMATEN)
vcu_0159_0800efb4.description: Matches the Artery SDK usart_dma_transmitter_enable: writes (param_2 & 1) to bit 7 of CTRL3 (offset 0x14). Called from the USART initialisation vcu_0159_08001ee8, alongside usart_dma_receiver_enable.

vcu_0159_0800efc8.name: usart_flag_get
vcu_0159_0800efc8.summary: Test whether any given USART STS flag is set (SDK usart_flag_get)
vcu_0159_0800efc8.description: Matches the Artery SDK usart_flag_get: returns 1 if (USART->sts & flag) is non-zero, else 0; the STS register is at offset 0. Called from the USART RX interrupt handler vcu_0159_08008c98 to check flags such as RDBF/IDLEF/ROERR before reading data with usart_data_receive.

vcu_0159_0800f03c.name: usart_receiver_enable
vcu_0159_0800f03c.summary: Enable or disable the USART receiver (CTRL1.REN)
vcu_0159_0800f03c.description: Matches the Artery SDK usart_receiver_enable: writes (param_2 & 1) to bit 2 (REN) of CTRL1 (offset 0xC). Called from the USART init vcu_0159_08001ee8.

vcu_0159_0800f046.name: usart_transmitter_enable
vcu_0159_0800f046.summary: Enable or disable the USART transmitter (CTRL1.TEN)
vcu_0159_0800f046.description: Matches the Artery SDK usart_transmitter_enable: writes (param_2 & 1) to bit 3 (TEN) of CTRL1 (offset 0xC). Called from the USART init vcu_0159_08001ee8.

vcu_0159_0800f050.name: util_map_range_clamp_high
vcu_0159_0800f050.summary: Linear interpolation of x from [in_min,in_max] to [out_min,out_max], clamped at the top
vcu_0159_0800f050.description: Integer version of the Arduino map() function. If x (param_1) is greater than in_max (param_3) it returns out_max (param_5); otherwise returns (out_max - out_min) * (x - in_min) / (in_max - in_min) + out_min using signed 32-bit division. There is no lower clamp, so x < in_min extrapolates below out_min, and in_max == in_min with x <= in_max would divide by zero. Used from several callers (vcu_0159_08009240, 0800b0c4, 0800e60c), probably to scale sensor/throttle or speed values; the exact use is not determined here.

vcu_0159_0800f0b8.name: wdt_counter_reload
vcu_0159_0800f0b8.summary: Feed the independent watchdog (write 0xAAAA to WDT.CMD)
vcu_0159_0800f0b8.description: Matches the Artery SDK wdt_counter_reload: writes WDT_CMD_RELOAD (0xAAAA) to the WDT command register, reloading the down-counter from RLD. Called from vcu_0159_080028e0 (watchdog setup) and vcu_0159_0800d858 (likely the periodic main-loop/tick routine that kicks the dog).

vcu_0159_0800f0c8.name: wdt_divider_set
vcu_0159_0800f0c8.description: Matches the Artery SDK wdt_divider_set: read-modify-write of the DIV register (0x40003004) replacing bits 2:0 with (param_1 & 7); values 0..6 correspond to dividers /4../256 of the LICK clock. Part of the watchdog setup in vcu_0159_080028e0, after wdt_register_write_enable(1).

vcu_0159_0800f0e8.name: wdt_register_write_enable
vcu_0159_0800f0e8.summary: Unlock or lock write access to WDT DIV/RLD (WDT.CMD key)
vcu_0159_0800f0e8.description: Matches the Artery SDK wdt_register_write_enable: non-zero argument writes the unlock key 0x5555 to the WDT command register so DIV and RLD can be modified; zero writes 0x0000 to lock them again. Called from watchdog setup vcu_0159_080028e0 around wdt_divider_set and wdt_reload_value_set.

vcu_0159_0800f100.name: wdt_reload_value_set
vcu_0159_0800f100.summary: Set the WDT reload value (write WDT.RLD)
vcu_0159_0800f100.description: Matches the Artery SDK wdt_reload_value_set: stores param_1 into the RLD register (0x40003008); only the low 12 bits are meaningful (0..0xFFF). Must be preceded by wdt_register_write_enable(1). Called from watchdog setup vcu_0159_080028e0.
